name: Micro Brick Cascade
description: The first clip fractures into a dense wall of tiny square tiles; a diagonal cascade releases the tiles in staggered waves, so they fall and drift aside while the second clip is revealed beneath. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: tile_size
params.description: Size of each square tile, relative to the frame height

params.name: fall
params.description: Downward falling strength of released tiles

params.name: drift
params.description: Sideways drift while the tiles fall

params.name: diagonal
params.description: How diagonal the release wave is

params.name: glow
params.description: Brightness of the highlight on the edges of the moving tiles
